title: Markdown twins of authored pages show template directives, not the page's content
description: On Machines on Machines, /index.md contains only the title, description, canonical line and raw directives such as ::band and ::include{kind="references" select="recent" ...}. It lists no stories, references or conversations, so it is not the content of the home page. /wire/index.md and /conversations/index.md behave the same on the live site, and a new /stories/ page built from a block include has the same problem. Reported by Ryan, 2026-11-04. Expected: a page's Markdown twin carries what the page shows: includes and blocks are rendered to Markdown lists with titles and links, and no directive reaches a reader or an agent. See _home_markdown, _authored_markdown and _static_twin_documents in projection/standard/projector.py. It matters for the shared page actions (PPY-77df353c), which link to these twins on every page. Needs a Gherkin scenario, including a site hook's block include.
